data.body: [P1] Waiting for `executionFuture` here means the following `.handle(...)` is attached only after completion, so `onInvocationEnd` now runs on the invocation caller for every plugin, including unannotated legacy plugins. Previously it ran on the handler worker with `onInvocationStart`; plugins using that hook for `ThreadLocal` state can no longer read or clear it and leak state into reused executor threads (`preservingMdc` only repairs MDC). Preserve handler-thread end dispatch for unannotated plugins, including mixed configurations, and add a reused-worker `ThreadLocal` regression test.
